handoff.must_be_able_to_do: Harden the design without going back to the designer for the reasons behind it: every design decision traces to an insight or a named assumption, and every component used is in the design system or listed as a gap
handoff.does_not_include: Production-ready design, a finished visual theme (without a design system, theme exploration comes after Design v1), engineering specifications, and any testing not yet done
